I am comparing two train tickets for a weekend visit. The flexible ticket costs 64 euros and can be refunded until the day before departure. The cheaper ticket costs 41 euros but cannot be refunded. My sister, Darya Petrenko, offered to meet me at the station if her shift ends on time.

My unrelated medical note says that I have migraines twice a month.
